title: 'Barrio Aswang': Horror theme park in Bulacan brings Filipino folklore to life for Halloween
summary: For those looking for a frightening experience this Halloween, a horror theme park in Baliwag, Bulacan is bringing some of the Philippines’ most feared mythical creatures to life.
